name: Ranger Freebooter — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Ranger Freebooter from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Freebooter" but are not part of the Ranger Freebooter entry, which is unchanged.

FAQ

Pirates of the Inner Sea, Freebooter: A freebooter ranger has quarry but not favored enemy. How does a freebooter use quarry?

A freebooter’s quarry must be the target of the freebooter’s freebooter’s bane ability, rather than a favored enemy.

[Source]

This ability replaces favored enemy.

Freebooter’s Bond (Ex)

This ability replaces woodland stride.

“FAQ: A freebooter ranger has quarry but not favored enemy. How does a freebooter use quarry?
